page_title: CHE 5-0 WHU | Chelsea v West Ham 05/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+6' Chelsea have a corner.
90+5' A cross from a corner kick by West Ham is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Mauricio Pochettino decides to make a substitution. Cole Palmer will be replaced by Alfie Gilchrist (Chelsea).
86' The corner is swung in but West Ham can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
85' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) misses a great chance. He gets to the rebound inside the box and sees his shot smash against the crossbar!
83' Substitution. Malo Gusto (Chelsea) has come on for Trevoh Chalobah.
82' Here is a change. Thiago Silva is going off and Mauricio Pochettino gives the last tactical orders to Axel Disasi (Chelsea).

82' Referee Andy Madley points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. That prompts big celebrations from the Chelsea players. A superb goal from great team play! Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent low shot inside the right post. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
81' Wait! Referee Andy Madley immediately makes the VAR signal, most likely to see if there was an offside in the build-up play.
80' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
77' Today's match ends for Noni Madueke who will be replaced by Cesare Casadei (Chelsea).
77' Mauricio Pochettino prepares a substitution. Mykhailo Mudryk is replaced by Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea).
76' Lucas Paqueta will be replaced by Aaron Cresswell (West Ham).
73' Alphonse Areola pulls off a great save to deny Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the middle of the goal.
70' The substitution has been made. Danny Ings (West Ham) has replaced Michail Antonio.
67' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) leaps like a salmon and powers a header in at goal from the corner, but his close-range effort is poor and goes way over the bar.
67' West Ham have been awarded a corner kick.
67' Michail Antonio (West Ham) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. Corner kick. West Ham will have an opportunity.
67' A quickly taken corner by Chelsea.
66' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) takes the ball, nicely zig-zags through the defence, but his low drive to the right post is smartly dealt with by Alphonse Areola.
64' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) latches on to an accurate pass into the box and immediately unleashes a low shot goalwards. His effort is well saved by the keeper.
63' Chelsea can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
61' Chelsea players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
56' West Ham take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
56' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) releases a promising shot from the set piece towards the top left corner, but Djordje Petrovic makes a save to deny him.
53' CHANCE! Emerson (West Ham) picks up a perfect pass inside the box, makes himself some space for a shot, but his effort goes just over the crossbar.

49' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the middle of the goal is blocked by Alphonse Areola, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
48' 4 - 0 Goal! Noni Madueke passes the ball to the feet of Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea), who has an empty net in front of him and has no problems in tapping the ball in. 4:0.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. David Moyes probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Edson Alvarez. He is replaced by James Ward-Prowse (West Ham).
46' The whistle blows and Andy Madley starts the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) has tested the patience of referee Andy Madley and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
45+1' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) unleashes a powerful shot from the free kick but it only hits the defensive wall.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
44' Emerson (West Ham) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
44' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) fails to score from inside the six-yard box and his rebound goes away off the crossbar.
43' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) goes on a mazy run and tries his luck with a mid-range strike, but one of the defending players steps in and makes a block.
38' Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
38' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) picks up a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot goalwards that crashes against the bar. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
36' 3 - 0 Goal! Thiago Silva finds Noni Madueke (Chelsea) with a headed pass and the latter glances a header past the goalkeeper to make it 3:0.
36' The ball goes out of play and Chelsea have been awarded a corner kick.
35' Great solo effort from Noni Madueke (Chelsea)! He beat a couple of players and shot from the edge of the box, but the effort slips just wide of the left post.
34' Angelo Ogbonna (West Ham) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
34' Total attempts – 9:1.
33' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) has time on the edge of the box. His shot is disappointing, though, as it flies towards the middle of the goal where Alphonse Areola makes a comfortable save.
30' 2 - 0 Goal! Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 2:0.
28' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) controls a square pass, he moves forward then unleashes a wild shot from mid-range which goes so far wide it nearly hits the corner flag.
26' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the middle of the goal, but Alphonse Areola is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
25' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
24' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Andy Madley blows his whistle for a foul.
24' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) takes the corner with a short pass.
23' A cross into the box from Cole Palmer (Chelsea) is cleared. Chelsea force their opponents to concede a corner.
23' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
22' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) blows a huge opportunity! He latches on to a perfect cross from the wing into the penalty area, but sends a bullet header just wide of the left post!
21' Emerson (West Ham) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Djordje Petrovic, who smothers the ball.
19' Trevoh Chalobah (Chelsea) jumps inside the box to meet the resulting set piece and aims a header towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes and makes a superb save.
18' Chelsea force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
18' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
17' A cross arrives in the goalmouth from the resulting corner kick. Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) outjumps the defence, but his promising header bounces away off the bar!
17' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. West Ham will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
15' 1 - 0 Goal! Cole Palmer (Chelsea) fires the rebound inside the left post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:0.
11' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Chelsea.

10' Alphonse Areola pulls off a great save to deny Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far!
7' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
6' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
4' The Chelsea players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
3' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) brings his opponent down. Andy Madley has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Chelsea will take the kick-off.
Andy Madley will referee today's match.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
Show lineups
Hello and welcome to our live text commentary! We will provide you with instant updates of everything that happens in the match. The starting lineups will be announced very soon.
